description: This file declares functions and structures related to the fsmonitor index extension in a version control system, providing interfaces for reading, writing, modifying, and refreshing the fsmonitor index extension, as well as checking responses.

methods.name: read_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Reads the fsmonitor index extension and optionally restores the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state.

methods.name: fill_fsmonitor_bitmap
methods.description: Fills the fsmonitor dirty ewah bits with their state from the index before it is split during writing.

methods.name: write_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Writes the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state into the fsmonitor index extension, reading from the fsmonitor_dirty ewah in the index.

methods.name: tweak_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adjusts the fsmonitor index extension based on the current core.fsmonitor setting.

methods.name: refresh_fsmonitor
methods.description: Runs the configured fsmonitor script, clears the valid bit for dirty files, and invalidates untracked cache directories.

methods.name: fsmonitor_is_trivial_response
methods.description: Checks if the received query result contains a trivial response.
